resources.string: KRYPTA does not encrypt the entire phone. New MOBILE/2 files can be recovered only with a separately backed-up 32-byte recovery key; old MOBILE/1 files remain device-bound.
AES-256-GCM with Android Keystore. New KRYPTA-MOBILE/2 is recoverable with an independent key; old MOBILE/1 files remain readable here. Not the desktop .kry format.
Choose a source file to begin.
Test operation completed. Keep the original and backup.
Operation failed. Output may be incomplete: delete it. Original unchanged.
Enable a secure device screen lock first.
Confirm device credential to access this device-bound key. No whole-phone encryption.

Save the NEW 32-byte recovery key on a separate trusted device before relying on this archive. Whoever has this key can decrypt the file. If both phone and key are lost, recovery is impossible. Use only test data.
Could not verify the exported recovery key. Encryption has been cancelled.
Select your separate 32-byte recovery keyfile. Anyone with this key can read the encrypted file. Only KRYPTA-MOBILE/2 supports this mode. Verify the source and export destination before continuing.
